newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pegasus shares rise sharply on debut.
newsitem.headline: Pegasus shares rise sharply on debut.

text.p: Shares of sport shoes maker Pegasus Holdings Ltd posted good initial gains on their first trading day on Friday, standing at HK$1.25 in early trade, up sharply from their issue price of HK$1.08 per share.
"Trading is quite active since investors are still keen to speculate on newly listed shares," a local broker said, adding that fundamentally the company was relatively stable.
The issue hit an early high of HK$1.30 before retreated to HK$1.23 after the first 25 minutes of trade. Turnover was a heavy 69.14 million shares worth HK$85.45 million.
Pegasus's 180.3 million new share offer was around 16.48 times oversubscribed.
